Subject: CAIQ scope + request for short telemetry clips

Jonas —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As part of our internal CAIQ review for vendor onboarding, we need a short technical package that maps a handful of CSA controls to the actual artifacts you can provide. Specifically the reviewers asked for:

- Mapping for controls around key lifecycle (KMS/rotation) and tenant isolation (runtime/session separation)
- One or two short log excerpts (10–50 lines) showing a successful key-rotation event and a request trace through your inference routing (redacted)
- A short note on retention policy for inference telemetry and where logs are stored (S3 path or equivalent)

Can you provide a small bundle (spreadsheet + one PDF policy + a log excerpt) by Friday 26 Jun? We will redact any PII on our side but would prefer redacted artifacts from you where possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps clarify format.

— Alicia

Hi all — attaching the initial package (see attachments). Short notes on contents: 

- caiq_tech_notes_v1.xlsx (attachment): Tab 1 = control mapping (CAIQ id / our interpretation / primary artifact pointer). Tab 2 = control-owner roster and evidence freshness date.
- key_rotation_policy_redacted.pdf (attachment): Extracted KMS policy with secrets/ARNs redacted; includes rotation cadence and automated verification steps.
- runtime_log_excerpt_20260622.txt (attachment): 35-line clip from our staging telemetry that demonstrates a key-rotation event followed by a routed inference request. We replaced tenant identifiers with T-REDACTED and removed payloads.

Retention note: our standard telemetry retention for runtime traces is 90 days in hot storage (encrypted S3), 2 years in cold encrypted archive for audit-sampling. Access to the logs for CAIQ review can be provided via view-only archive export (we can pre-sanitize or provide redaction guidance).

If you want a brief deck summarizing controls mapping for your execs, I can generate a 1-pager.

-- Marissa
